nodes.speaker: iris
nodes.text: Something's pinging out in the Scrapyard Flats. A terminal. Old Network kit, still on.

nodes.speaker: iris
nodes.text: Terminals remember things. Maps, plans, who went where. I want what's on it.

choices.text: We don't know how to hack anything.
Why don't you get it yourself?

nodes.speaker: iris
nodes.text: You will by tonight. There's a toolbox in the terminal room. Kit inside. I'll talk you through it.

nodes.speaker: iris
nodes.text: Because I don't go outside. That's a whole conversation. Not this one.

nodes.speaker: iris
nodes.text: Half of it's plans. Cloaks, mostly. Things that keep you from being seen. You'll want those.

nodes.speaker: iris
nodes.text: One more thing. Don't hack the camera. Hack the thing the camera reports to. Always go one step up.

nodes.speaker: iris
nodes.text: Okay, I'm reading it. Patrol logs. Crop yields. A list of names with ticks next to them. Not ours. Not... anyone's anymore.

nodes.speaker: iris
nodes.text: And a cloak pattern. Camo, the good kind. Your Tailor can make it now.

nodes.speaker: iris
nodes.text: And you shot at the Tally. Cole keeps lists. You're on one now.

nodes.speaker: iris
nodes.text: You split it with the Tally? Cole Brannigan doesn't split anything. He must like you. Or he's counting.

nodes.speaker: iris
nodes.text: Keep the kit. You'll be hacking a lot more than lockers before this is over.

nodes.speaker: iris
nodes.text: The terminal's still pinging. Somebody'll get to it eventually. Better it's you.

nodes.speaker: iris
nodes.text: This time, bring bandages. Hacks bite.
